tool_args.rationale: The recalled mechanism calls for at least eight rows, while the pilot provides only five for a five-parameter coupled ODE. The trajectory batch directly addresses that identifiability gap.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the five-parameter siphon-memory ODE to the pilot rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five observations do not adequately identify five coupled parameters or distinguish competing fits.
Neither incorporates the observed coupled transient lag; additional trajectory observations can test the ODE mechanism.
The auxiliary measurement is not relevant to identifying the proposed mechanism.
